primary_model: blend: mean of the logistic and boosting outcome probabilities
winner_probabilities: frozen winner model (config_frozen.json, B average), refitted on fights before the test

pass_rule.1: method and round given the winner: log loss lower than base rates, 95% event-bootstrap interval of the difference below zero (all decided 3- and 5-round fights)
pass_rule.2: knockout / submission / decision with the winner model: log loss lower than base rates, interval below zero (fights with usable opening odds)
pass_rule.3: exact outcome (winner, method, round) with the winner model: log loss lower than base rates with the same winner probabilities, interval below zero
pass_rule.note: the comparison with bookmakers' method odds is reported but is not part of the pass rule
